items.title: Ivanti發布10月例行更新，修補已遭利用的SSL VPN漏洞
items.summary: 資安廠商Ivanti於10月13日發布本月例行更新（Patch Tuesday），修補旗下應用系統Ivanti Connect Secure（ICS）、Ivanti Neurons Patch for Intune，以及Xtraction。其中最值得留意的是漏洞已遭利用的ICS，該公司已掌握少數實際利用的情形，並與受影響的客戶合作，呼籲用戶應根據資安公告的內容，儘速升級至新版本，並定期執行系統完整性檢查工具，以防ICS遭到入侵及竄改。

items.title: OpenAI工程師涉嫌安裝竊聽裝置遭FBI逮捕
items.summary: 美國司法部周二（10/13）宣布，美國聯邦調查局（FBI）已逮捕一名涉嫌在OpenAI辦公室安裝秘密錄音裝置的工程師。35歲的沙烏地阿拉伯籍男子Abdulrahman Alfozan於10月9日遭逮捕，目前仍遭聯邦拘留，若罪名成立，最高面臨5年徒刑及25萬美元罰款。

items.title: Google發布ChromeOS與ChromeOS Flex穩定版更新，修補106個資安漏洞
items.summary: ChromeOS與ChromeOS Flex作業系統穩定版的更新16805.33.0，於10月9日上線，並納入106個資安漏洞的修補，其中有5個漏洞被評為重大等級，44個漏洞為高風險等級。 從這次漏洞修補涉及的元件類型來看，是以JavaScript引擎V8最多，一共有12個漏洞，其次是開發工具DevTools，占9個漏洞，然後是系統介面元件Views與圖形處理元件GPU，各有4個漏洞。

items.title: Rust型別檢查漏洞藏近11年，違反記憶體安全限制的程式仍可通過編譯
items.summary: Rust編譯器被發現存在記憶體安全漏洞，開發者在GitHub通報，即使程式未使用unsafe關鍵字，仍可繞過生命周期檢查，讓原本應被拒絕的程式通過編譯，執行時可能存取已失效的記憶體。Rust團隊已將問題列為高優先級，目前修補尚未完成。 Rust透過所有權與借用檢查，限制程式參照資料的有效時間，避免資料失效後仍被讀取。依照設計，不符合生命周期限制的程式應在編譯階段遭到阻止，未使用unsafe的Rust程式碼，原則上不應產生這類記憶體安全問題。

items.title: 荷蘭連鎖超市Albert Heijn遭遇資安事件，網站、App及電子貨架標籤受影響
items.summary: 荷蘭大型零售集團Ahold Delhaize發生資安事件，旗下連鎖超市Albert Heijn的網站、App及線上購物服務中斷，物流系統與實體門市的電子貨價標籤也受到影響。目前業者正逐步恢復服務，事件原因仍在調查中。

items.title: test(crabbox): pin warm-image snapshot keys (#171880)
items.summary: test(crabbox): pin warm-image snapshot keys (#171880) A live Gateway update on 2026-10-14 silently sent the next cloud session cold: #171073 had (deliberately) changed the warm-image profile fingerprint for every profile, and the only test touching the key asserted that it differed from an old value, never what it is. Golden tests now pin the exact Crabbox warm-image profile key and the preparation and cache keys for one canonical Linux profile without setup secrets, each with a note that changing the value invalidates every user's warm images on update and must be deliberate and explained. Test-only; no production change and no key change. Refs: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171880

items.title: fix(discord): bind channel tool policy to resolved channel ids (#171829)
items.summary: fix(discord): bind channel tool policy to resolved channel ids (#171829) The Discord group-policy adapter that core uses for per-channel tools, toolsBySender, and requireMention matched guild channel name/slug keys against the conversation label. For threads that label is the thread name, which any member who can create threads chooses, so a thread named after a privileged channel entry took that entry's policy; the monitor itself never matches thread names. Name/slug keys resolved at startup or live-policy reload now bind to their channel id: other channels and threads sharing the name fall back to the guild policy, and the bound channel keeps its entry after a rename. Id entries still win, and unresolved name keys keep the documented name matching. Accepted edge: a superseded live-policy resolution can briefly publish its bindings before the newer one lands. Refs #168134.

items.title: fix(state): prevent large fleets staying degraded after startup (#168…
items.summary: fix(state): prevent large fleets staying degraded after startup (#168638) * fix(state): retry typed startup journal-read overloads with backoff The startup 8-permit journal bound caps this producer's fan-out, but the shared state-read pool rejects admission whenever other sources already occupy its 128 pending slots; that rejection reached the preparation catch and marked healthy agents permanently degraded. Retry only the typed transient overload on the journal-read boundary with bounded abort-aware backoff, re-acquiring the permit and re-validating the admission between attempts, so tombstone verdicts and genuine read failures stay terminal. * fix(state): preserve startup ownership while waiting for journal reads Keep the startup journal limit private and reuse existing permit and retry owners. Revalidate ownership after permit acquisition, before worker reads. Consolidate deterministic regressions for 140 agents, transient capacity, terminal failures, and revoked ownership without real backoff waits. Fixes #168585 Original fix by @ruel225; maintainer cleanup preserves bounded startup reads and shared-pool overload recovery. Tests and typechecks are delegated to PR CI under maintainer policy; local validation is changed-file lint/format. Co-authored-by: ruel225 * test(state): omit redundant deferred type arguments --------- Co-authored-by: ruel225 Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
